title: Vanishing directional-derivative integrals force translation invariance of a locally finite measure
statement: Let P ∈ ℕ, ν a Borel measure on ℝ^P = Euclid P with ν(K) < ∞ for every compact K ⊆ ℝ^P, and v ∈ ℝ^P. Assume ∫Dφ(y)[v] dν(y) = 0 (the Bochner integral of y ↦ fderiv ℝ φ y v) for every C^∞ function φ : ℝ^P → ℝ with compact support. Then ν({x : v + x ∈ A}) = ν(A) for every Borel set A ⊆ ℝ^P, i.e. ν is invariant under the translation by v.
lean_statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (ν : Measure (Euclid P)) (v : Euclid P), (∀ K : Set (Euclid P), IsCompact K → ν K < ∞) → (∀ φ : Euclid P → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) φ → HasCompactSupport φ → ∫ y, fderiv ℝ φ y v ∂ν = 0) → ∀ A : Set (Euclid P), MeasurableSet A → ν ((fun x => v + x) ⁻¹' A) = ν A
